title: LibScript Tier 3.5 Topology Runtime State Machine (.topology_state.json)
description: Persistent checkpoint state schema tracking cluster epochs, active leader IDs, distributed lease locks, per-node state transitions, and provisioned cloud resource IDs.

topology_name.description: Identifier of the cluster topology instance

epoch.description: Monotonically increasing cluster consensus term or state mutation epoch counter

status.description: Overall lifecycle state of the topology deployment

active_leader_id.description: Node identifier of the currently elected or active cluster leader

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last atomic checkpoint write

lock.description: Distributed lease lock metadata preventing concurrent topology mutations

holder_id.description: Unique identifier of the CLI or REST API operator holding the lease

acquired_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the lease lock was acquired

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the lease lock expires if not renewed

lock_backend.description: Storage backend coordinating the distributed lock lease

nodes.description: Per-node state machine records and cloud resource mappings

items.description: State record for an individual node in the topology

node_id.description: Unique node instance identifier within the topology

group.description: Originating node group name from topology.schema.json

role.description: Current consensus role assigned to the node

state.description: Deterministic node lifecycle state transition marker

provider.description: Cloud or hypervisor provider hosting this node

public_ip.description: External routable IPv4/IPv6 address assigned to the node

private_ip.description: VPC private IPv4/IPv6 address assigned to the node

mesh_ip.description: Encrypted overlay IPv4/IPv6 address on the WireGuard/Tailscale mesh (e.g. 100.64.0.1)

wireguard_pubkey.description: Base64-encoded WireGuard public key for peer mesh configuration

resources.description: Cloud provider resource identifiers tracked for deterministic cascade deprovisioning and API fencing

vm_id.description: Cloud provider virtual machine or instance identifier

nic_ids.description: Provisioned network interface identifiers attached to the node

volume_ids.description: Provisioned persistent block storage volume identifiers

dns_record_ids.description: Cloud DNS A/AAAA record identifiers mapped to this node for clean teardown via dns unmap-node

items.description: Cloud DNS record resource ID or FQDN mapping
